news.title: Whitmer makes ‘science of reading’ training mandatory for Michigan teachers
news.summary_en: As Michigan struggles with low literacy test scores, leaders are putting in a new training requirement for elementary teachers.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Whitmer signs education budget: What to know about college affordability
news.summary_en: Michigan’s education budget includes a new dual enrollment effort that could help students save money on college costs.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
